gen-fs-new-title-gf-pridi: Pridi is a serif with small letters that stand almost as tall as its capitals, and generous gaps where curves meet stems. New Title is the bolder voice, its tall lowercase linked tight like a fine chain, while Pridi does the refined, quieter work.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, its sans curves opening wide with barely any step up to the capitals. Manrope keeps one steady line while Alien Encounters spaces its letter pairs far apart, giving the page a faintly technological hum.
gen-dafont-azonix-general-sans: Azonix commands attention with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, so words take a moment to knit back together. General Sans then fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth bends, giving the page somewhere easy to land.
gen-dafont-bloody-montserrat: Big, round lowercase bowls give Bloody its heavy, commanding presence the moment it appears. And Montserrat answers with a geometric sans-serif line, gliding along with oversized e and a counters and plenty of white space.
gen-dafont-college-satoshi: Dynamic energy comes from College, whose curves are as thick as its stems and whose counters are big. Satoshi, a sans with a soaring x-height and an open e, is the one that handles the quieter, steadier lines.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-work-sans: Lowercase letters with the stature of cast iron capitals give Edo SZ a weight that feels almost carved. But Work Sans, a sans with a high mean line and wide c tips, is the one built to keep text moving.
gen-dafont-blockletter-fs-supreme: Blockletter draws every stroke with the same pencil pressure, tall in the middle. Supreme is the one for running text, forming a crisp, heavy-looking band of sans-serif letters that stay held open.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-merriweather-san: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy and large, a plain sans with tall lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Against Bushcraft's closed, widely spaced letters, that openness is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans looks sharp and refined, with generous space where its curves meet the stems. Phudu brings the bold ballpoint line and open terminals, so a larger size for Phudu and a modest one for Bespoke Sans feels natural.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-bespoke-sans: Pixelify Sans draws everything with an unvarying line, including a c as open as a bent paperclip, and it makes the bolder statement. And Bespoke Sans does the sharper, more refined work, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems.
